query: UPDATE agent_dm_turn_journal AS candidate SET state = 'running', in_flight = $2, updated_at = now() WHERE action_id = $1 AND state = 'queued' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_dm_turn_journal other WHERE other.session_id = candidate.session_id AND (other.state IN ('running', 'interrupted') OR (other.state = 'queued' AND (other.created_at, other.source_message_id) < (candidate.created_at, candidate.source_message_id))))
